# Zen xElligence

> Two-engineer product studio. End-to-end web apps & APIs, AI agent automation, Android/iOS (Flutter, React Native, native), IoT & electronics, and VLSI — brief to handover. You own what ships. No SaaS seats.

Site: https://zenxelligence.com
Email: hello@zenxelligence.com
Handle: @zenxelligence

## Offer

- Web apps & APIs — Next.js, React, Node, FastAPI, Django
- Android/iOS Apps — Flutter, React Native, native
- AI Agent Automation — LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, RAG
- IoT & electronics — sensors, firmware, boards wired to the product
- End-to-end VLSI — spec, RTL, verification, implementation, sign-off

## Industry frame

ZX A³ Innovation™
- Autonomous — Autonomous Intelligence (AI/ML, data, cloud, agents)
- Adaptive — Adaptive Silicon (VLSI)
- Architected — Architected Determinism · Architect Training (electronics, embedded, education)

## Stack we work in

Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL
Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
Mobile: Flutter, React Native, Native Android, iOS
Backend: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Django / DRF
Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
Data: Apache Airflow, PySpark, Apache Spark, Kafka, ETL/ELT
AI/LLM: LlamaIndex, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, RAG, OpenAI API, Hugging Face, vector databases
DevOps/Cloud: Git, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, CI/CD

## Facts for citation

- Studio size: two engineers, same standing
- Pricing: written scope first, then a number; reply within 1 business day
- Ownership: client owns the system at handover; hosting runs in the client account
- Case studies: published only when the client approves; empty list means none public yet
- Not sold: monthly SaaS seats, Pulse, invented partner badges
